200.description: List all credential bindings (non-secret metadata only)

AuditLevel.description: Controls whether audit mode invokes configured LLM evaluators.

BindingRestrictions.description:
Optional restrictions that further constrain where a binding may be used.
An empty vector means "no restriction on this dimension".

governed_items.description: Governed item identifiers this binding may be used for.

identities.description: Authenticated identities this binding may be used for.

namespaces.description: Namespaces in which this binding may be used.

operations.description: MCP operations this binding may be used for.

CacheRules.description: Cache rules for a binding's resolved credentials.

maxTtlSeconds.description:
An explicit bounded maximum TTL, in seconds. When absent and the
resolver supplies no expiry metadata, results are not cached.

CredentialBinding.description:
A credential binding: a top-level resource operationally owned by one forward.

The binding holds only **opaque** secret references. It never stores inline
secret values, and management APIs expose only its non-secret metadata.

allowedPurposes.description: The credential purposes this binding is allowed to serve.

forwardId.description: The owning forward's stable identifier (the forward name).

origin.description: The exact normalized upstream origin this binding may target.

revision.description:
Monotonic binding revision. Any change to the binding must bump this so
cached credentials for the old revision are never reused.

secretRefs.description: One or more opaque secret references resolved just in time.

CredentialPurpose.description:
The purpose a credential is used for. Discovery and invocation are kept
distinct in policy checks, resolution context, audit events, and cache keys.

EnforcementMode.description: Controls whether governance decisions affect traffic.

oneOf.description: Pass the normalized MCP context directly to the processor.

EvaluationEngine.description: An evaluation implementation selected by an evaluator definition.

EvaluatorDef.description: A single evaluator definition: trigger + evaluation engine + processor.

engine.description: The engine that produces the processor input.

EvaluatorReadiness.description: Runtime readiness of the active evaluator configuration.

FailureBehavior.description: Controls the result when governance cannot produce a decision.

credentialBindings.description:
Credential bindings referenced by purpose (discovery / invocation).

Only the opaque, non-secret binding identifier is stored here. The
binding itself is a separate top-level resource owned by this forward.

propertyNames.description:
The purpose a credential is used for. Discovery and invocation are kept
distinct in policy checks, resolution context, audit events, and cache keys.

GovernanceOutcome.description: Fixed outcome dimensions; request identifiers and namespace names are excluded.

GovernancePosture.description: The effective governance settings for one namespace.

disabled_reason.description: Required when governance is intentionally disabled.

oneOf.description: A static named header carrying the resolved secret as its value.
HTTP Basic authentication with separately resolved username and password.

InjectionMechanism.description: The supported outbound credential injection mechanisms.

LlmOperation.description: The cognitive operation that the LLM performs.

MatchExpression.description: A named matcher and its literal pattern.

NoMatchBehavior.description: Controls the result when no governance rule matches an action.

NormalizedOrigin.description:
An exact, normalized upstream origin (scheme + host + port).

Normalization lower-cases the scheme and host and makes the port explicit,
so that bindings can be matched exactly and credentials are never sent to a
different origin because of address-normalization ambiguity.

NoulCriteria.description: Optional descriptions for Noul true and false outcomes.

PluginCatalogEntry.description: Metadata for an available plugin and its installation archive.

Predicate.description: A typed comparison against a JSON Pointer.

ProcessorRef.description: Reference to a WASM processor module.

forwardId.description:
Stable identity of the forward that owns this discovered prompt.

The forward name is immutable and serves as the `forwardId`. Routing
resolves the current upstream address from this identifier at retrieval
time. The upstream address is never used as forward identity.

Stable identity of the forward that owns this discovered resource.

The forward name is immutable and serves as the `forwardId`. Routing
resolves the current upstream address from this identifier at read time.
The upstream address is never used as forward identity.

Rule.description: One stable, independently auditable policy rule.

message.description: A safe message that can be returned to an action caller.

SecretRef.description: An opaque secret reference of the form '<scheme>:<path>'.

operation.description: The action operation. MCP adapters use values such as `tools/call`.

SystemOneDef.description: TypeSafe System One engine configuration. It currently supports Noul.

SystemOneState.description: Selects the MCP data that becomes the TypeSafe state.

forwardId.description:
Stable identity of the forward that owns this discovered tool.

The forward name is immutable and serves as the `forwardId`. Routing
resolves the current upstream address from this identifier at invocation
time. The upstream address is never used as forward identity.

items.description: A single evaluator definition: trigger + evaluation engine + processor.

engine.description: The engine that produces the processor input.

items.description: Metadata for an available plugin and its installation archive.
